native_proof_script:
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import replace
import json,hashlib,capstone
from snail import match as m
from snail.symbols import load_function_symbol_manifest
p=Path('tools/match/scratches/initialize_start_path_template_pair');out=Path('/tmp/snail-goal-start');c=m.load_scratch_config(p);d=out/'compile-final';d.mkdir(exist_ok=True);source=(out/'direct-sample-fields.cpp').read_text();(d/'scratch.cpp').write_text(source);(d/'scratch.conf').write_text((p/'scratch.conf').read_text());cfg=replace(c,directory=d)
r=[];status=m.scratch_status_payload(m.evaluate_scratch(cfg,on_match=r.append));res=r[0];obj=m.extract_object_function(m.parse_coff_object(m.compile_scratch(cfg,m.DEFAULT_MATCH_ROOT).read_bytes()),c.symbol or c.function)
manifest=load_function_symbol_manifest(Path('analysis/symbols/gameplay-functions.json'));image=m.load_image(Path(manifest.primary_target),manifest.image_base);start,end=m.resolve_function_extent(manifest,c.function,c.end_va);native=image.function_bytes(start,end);md=capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_X86,capstone.CS_MODE_32);md.detail=True
rows=[]
for index,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(res.target_disassembly,res.candidate_disassembly)):
 left=bytearray(native[a.offset:a.offset+a.size]);right=bytearray(obj.data[b.offset:b.offset+b.size]);ta=next(md.disasm(bytes(left),a.offset));cb=next(md.disasm(bytes(right),b.offset));masked=[]
 if index>=300:
  assert a.offset==b.offset+2 and a.size==b.size
  for ref in b.masked_references:
   if ref.source!='reloc':continue
   field='imm' if ref.kind=='imm' else 'disp';offset=getattr(cb,field+'_offset');size=getattr(cb,field+'_size');assert offset==getattr(ta,field+'_offset') and size==getattr(ta,field+'_size')
   masked.append([offset,size]);left[offset:offset+size]=right[offset:offset+size]=bytes(size)
  local=m._local_branch_offsets(b)
  if local and b.offset+cb.imm_offset in obj.relocation_offsets:
   assert len(local)==1;size=cb.imm_size;right[cb.imm_offset:cb.imm_offset+size]=((local[0]-b.offset-b.size)%(1<<(8*size))).to_bytes(size,'little')
  if left!=right:print('tail byte difference',index,hex(a.offset),ta.mnemonic,ta.op_str,cb.mnemonic,cb.op_str,left.hex(),right.hex())
 rows.append({'index':index,'target_offset':a.offset,'candidate_offset':b.offset,'target':a.text,'candidate':b.text,'native_raw':native[a.offset:a.offset+a.size].hex(),'candidate_raw':obj.data[b.offset:b.offset+b.size].hex(),'region_audited_native':left.hex() if index>=300 else None,'region_audited_candidate':right.hex() if index>=300 else None,'masked_external_fields':masked})
audit=m._masked_audit_cache_payload(res.masked_operand_audit)
assert all(x['status']=='ok' for x in audit)
assert all(x['target_index']==x['candidate_index'] for x in audit if x['target_index']>=300)
proof={'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),'status':status,'native_bytes':native.hex(),'candidate_unlinked_bytes':obj.data.hex(),'instructions':rows,'reference_audit':audit,'stack_frame':m.stack_frame_diagnostic_payload(res),'tail_different_instructions':[x['index'] for x in rows if x['index']>=300 and x['region_audited_native']!=x['region_audited_candidate']]}
(out/'final-native-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n');print('current source',status['match_ratio'],'tail differences',proof['tail_different_instructions'])
